conclusion: Two independent reads of PacBio 2019 customer training PN 101-742-500 v01 pp. 7 and 9 establish Overhang Adapter v3's T overhang and A/T ligation; the model and page reflect this paired end. The complete hairpin body and sequencing-primer bases remain unverified.
